note: Where the owner's weekly spend list comes from, by region. Keys only: owner-facing names are i18n `ledger.app.<key>`. screenshot = apps whose spend-list screenshot the weekly sweep names (shot-stage --app takes any key below, plus 'other'). csv = apps whose export csv-import reads (Banksalad's format only). aggregators = screenshot apps that show every account's balance on one screen (one capture covers all accounts; the onboarding balance step asks for that one capture instead of one per account). A region not listed, or no region at all, uses `default`: no app is named, the sweep question asks which app or bank shows the spending, and the answer is kept as LEDGER_SPEND_APP.

lookup.note: Session lookups for current capture and export instructions (capture/how), official help first. Cache ttl_days. Only current official steps with a source URL receive an official-check label; current posts retain a separate source label. Failed or stale lookups use generic wording. official lists help entry points, never app menu paths. Legacy export availability verdicts remain readable.
